topic: remove light scratches from wood furniture
core_question: How do you get rid of shallow scratches on a wood furniture surface? (secondary: How do I introduce a new cat to my resident cat without conflict?)
answer_summary: Fill and blend the scratch using a color-matched wood touch-up stain marker or by rubbing a walnut over it to release oils that darken the scratch, then buff with a soft cloth.; after the topic shift: Keep the new cat isolated at first, swap scents via bedding, allow sniffing under a door, then use gradual supervised visual introductions before full face-to-face contact.
persona: tired and blunt; chatty and verbose
